name: qa-pipeline
description: A step-by-step QA pipeline of focused skills that turns a Jira issue into manual test documentation and runs it: step1-context -> step2-requirements -> step3-checklist -> step4-test-cases -> step5-execute. Each step reads one markdown artifact and writes the next, so context stays small. ISTQB test design, a choice of coverage level, a smoke gate and a MANUAL status at execution.
